name: Leto v pionerskom lagere
source:
The setting is the summer of 1985. An ordinary pioneer named Alexander arrives at the camp. He will have to get to know many of the pioneers in his group.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=913201430]Steam[/url]]
translation:
故事背景是1985年夏天，一位名叫亚历山大的普通拓荒者来到了营地。他必须认识他的团队中的许多先驱者。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=913201430]Steam[/url]]
